decisions.reason: The flagship transactional email service draws directly on the firm's core messaging expertise, its own data centers and its R&D, so it can interpret usage results and keep improving the service.

Document capture extends the firm's electronic document workflows and fits the push toward digital business processes, but recognition technology sits further from its messaging core, which leaves a moderate risk of refocusing.
Email-to-fax conversion relies on long-held channel integration know-how and still serves regulated customers who depend on fax, though overall fax demand is slowly declining.
This fax optimization feature costs little to maintain within the established fax service, but as fax shrinks it could be folded quietly into the base offering.
Sandbox threat protection strengthens the growing email security portfolio, where the firm's existing security knowledge lets it absorb new threat information and keep improving the product.
